description: This file defines utility functions and constants for configuring and creating Slack WebClient instances with specific retry options.

methods.name: export function resolveSlackWebClientOptions(options: WebClientOptions = {}): WebClientOptions { resolveSlackWebClientOptions
methods.description: Resolves and returns Slack WebClient options, applying default retry configuration if none is provided.

methods.name: export function resolveSlackWriteClientOptions(options: WebClientOptions = {}): WebClientOptions/ resolveSlackWriteClientOptions
methods.description: Resolves and returns Slack WebClient options, applying write-specific retry configuration if none is provided.

methods.name: export function createSlackWebClient(token: string, options: WebClientOptions = {}) { createSlackWebClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Slack WebClient instance with provided token and options.

methods.name: export function createSlackWriteClient(token: string, options: WebClientOptions = {}) { createSlackWriteClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Slack WebClient instance for write operations with provided token and options.
